comment:
* Compat class which provides access to the underlying display mode, if there is one, and
     * a more reliable display mode size.

methods.name: public int getPhysicalWidth()
methods.comment: * Returns the physical width of the given display when configured in this mode.

methods.name: public int getPhysicalHeight()
methods.comment: * Returns the physical height of the given display when configured in this mode.

methods.name: public boolean isNative()
methods.comment:
* This field indicates whether a mode has the same resolution as the current display mode. *

* This field does *not* indicate the native resolution of the display. * * @return true if this mode is the same resolution as the current display mode. * @deprecated Use {@link DisplayCompat#getMode} to retrieve the resolution of the current * display mode.

methods.name: public Display.@Nullable Mode toMode()
methods.comment: * Returns the wrapped object Display.Mode, which may be null if no mode is available.
